findings.message: Unary operator `++` used. It mutates its operand and evaluates to a different value depending on which side it sits, so `a[i++]` and `a[++i]` read almost identically and index different elements. Automatic semicolon insertion compounds it: a line ending in a value followed by a line starting with `++` joins into one statement. Write the assignment out as `x += 1`, which does one thing and reads the same wherever it appears.
